title: Windows hidden-desktop GUI suite (hosted and local)

steps.description: Start a portable measurement copy, see its shell start, close it with WM_CLOSE.
Run -e cmd and PowerShell stimuli; the CLI resolves and prints its fixed strings.
Drive a single-instance copy through the CLI's IPC actions.
Exact tab and pane counts across close, undo and redo.
Saved tabs and selected tab, the session file unchanged across -e, restore and quarantine.

assertions.description: Every leaf in the plan exits 0 on the private desktop.
Every declared shell is System32's cmd.exe with /D before its payload, and every noctty process was started by the launcher.
No leaf loaded the real-input module.
The real startup state, PSReadLine history, jump list and clipboard sequence are unchanged.
